name: Spouse Abuse
overview: Scripture condemns violence and treachery within marriage, emphasizing that God hates putting away a spouse and covering violence with a garment of deceit. Husbands are instructed to love their wives without bitterness, fostering peace rather than strife or contention. Divorce is only permitted in the case of fornication, and causing a wife to be put away otherwise leads to adultery. These teachings highlight the sacredness of the marital bond and call for righteous, loving conduct between spouses.
